zh.title: 阿拉斯加航空將於2027年退役737-700客機，改由737-800接替
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空將於2027年退役737-700客機並以737-800接替
body: Simple Flying報導，阿拉斯加航空將於2027年退役波音737-700客機機隊。報導所述時程為2027年，退役對象是該公司的客運機隊。
報導並稱，阿拉斯加航空將以較大型的737-800接替這批客機，目標是在阿拉斯加增加座位及貨運空間。這項機隊調整涉及退役機型與接替機型，報導所述的容量方向包括客運座位和貨運空間。

en.title: Alaska Airlines to Retire 737-700 Passenger Fleet in 2027
en.summary: Alaska Airlines plans to retire its 737-700 passenger fleet in 2027 and replace it with 737-800s.
body: Simple Flying reports that Alaska Airlines will retire its Boeing 737-700 passenger fleet in 2027. The report identifies the aircraft as part of the airline’s passenger fleet and gives 2027 as the retirement timing.

The report says Alaska Airlines will replace the aircraft with larger 737-800s in Alaska. It describes the intended benefits as more seats and cargo space. The stated fleet change therefore covers the retirement of the 737-700 passenger aircraft and their replacement by the larger 737-800 type, with seating and cargo capacity named as the areas the change is intended to increase.
